reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here shows reviews or a track record, and I don't spend $360 with a store I can't check out first. Add 10 to 12 business days of waiting and a return policy where I eat the shipping, and I'd just go back to the showroom or a retailer I know.
objection: Is this store even legit? No reviews, no Trustpilot, no track record I can see, and I'd wait two-plus weeks for a light I can't see in person, with return shipping on me if it looks wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of verified reviews on Trustpilot or Google with real customer photos of the pendant installed, plus free returns or a faster delivery window.
